d: FC Barcelona delivered a dominant performance to secure a convincing 4–1 victory over Sabah FK in Baku. After taking an early lead, Barcelona stepped up their attacking intensity in the second half, with Anthony Gordon completing his brace, while Karim Adeyemi and Gabriel Jesus also found the net. Sabah FK managed to pull one back through substitute Joy-Lance Mickels, but Barcelona remained in control to seal an impressive Champions League victory.
